description: This file defines a PHP class `ValidationDecorator` in the namespace `OrangeHRM\Core\Api\V2\Validator\Helpers`. The class provides methods to modify `ParamRule` objects to mark parameters as required or not required, with options to exclude empty strings in validation logic.

classes.name: ValidationDecorator
classes.description: Provides methods to decorate validation rules for parameters, specifically to mark them as required or not required with specific rules for handling empty strings.

methods.name: requiredParamRule
methods.description: Modifies a ParamRule to make it required, optionally excluding empty strings from being considered valid.

methods.name: notRequiredParamRule
methods.description: Modifies a ParamRule to make it not required, with an option to consider empty strings as acceptable or not.
